title: 달빛 능선의 대공 방어
prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: NEW distinct AsteraCraft cinematic loading scene, widescreen landscape 16:9, no UI, text or logo.
Story: A single actual citrus THORN-FLOWER anti-air unit defends a moonlit bare limestone ridge from ONE existing enemy ivory/red owl delta fighter banking across the open sky. The flower fires a few thin THORNS upward from its actual short cannon, NOT a continuous beam. Make the visible defender and airborne threat share the same line of action so the defense story reads immediately. No worker, no mining crystals, no roots arching over a foreground subject, no sunny jungle.
Input1 is the actual thorn-flower design; input2 is the existing enemy delta fighter. Technical sprite cameras are identity diagrams only. Last input is only a photoreal material benchmark, NEVER copy its forest or characters.
Identity: thorn-flower compact dark bronze central chassis, a ring of SIX slender pointed orange fruit/petal lobes fanning around the body, green leaf mantle BETWEEN orange petals, slender green leaf/root legs, ONE thin cyan-tipped vertical antenna and ONE existing short forward bronze/dark cannon. A flower-shaped fan of elongated orange lobes, not a bunch of round orange balls, not a healer, no gun turret added. Naturally attached green veined leaves and porous orange peel MUST remain visible. Fighter is the actual flat triangular ivory delta wing with red wing panels, black canopy and gold pointed nose from input2, no owl head or new missile pods.
Composition: a WIDE HORIZONTAL SIDE VIEW at the thorn-flower's body height. Defender is a modest full-body subject in the far RIGHT third, almost SIDE PROFILE facing LEFT, legs braced on a chalky ridge; muzzle angles gently upward toward fighter in the far LEFT upper sky. Broad open negative sky in middle, distant pale mountains and a tiny moonlit river far below. Eye-level horizon behind the defender. Do not fill the entire image with a huge creature, do not look from beneath a tree, do not recreate a close-up fruit-and-worker arrangement.
Light and medium: believable live-action night photography, cool silver-blue moonlight on rough bare limestone and low grasses, small restrained cyan reflections on dew-wet leaf veins, natural physical bronze and peel, dust and realistic fighter exhaust. Dim but readable, no neon glow, toy gloss, miniature diorama, product render or isometric game view. Keep all actual units physically grounded and recognizable. Exactly one thorn-flower and one fighter, no other creatures, no invented units or buildings.
